verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is fully open-source software installed and run entirely on user-controlled machines (Debian install, ROS-Base bare-bones install, no cloud dependency), with full CLI/API access and no vendor lock-in — inherently self-hostable by design. missing for 10: no explicit first-party 'self-hosting' guide or enterprise on-prem deployment doc beyond standard install instructions, and no independent report confirming large-scale self-hosted production use.
